column1: # key_spec: canonical_mode_key in derive_angular_response.py; vectors in test/data/mode_keys.json
# range_ref_source: median slant range of the reference mode

# range_term_lookup: a beam uses the range rows whose angle_lo_deg <= |angle| < angle_hi_deg; below the first angle_lo_deg (the specular band) it uses the first group; a mode or group with no range rows has a zero term
# absorption: not modelled separately; the per-mode range term carries it
# offset_meaning: offset_db_vs_ref is the level a mode reads above the reference mode after db_relative_to_nadir and its range term are removed from both
column2: measured at mode switches; the corrected beam is raw - db_relative_to_nadir - r - offset_db_vs_ref
column3: on the reference mode's nadir level at R0; a mode with offset_anchored=false has NO offset (the columns are empty) and must not be corrected by this table

column1: # empty_fields: var_db2 is empty where it cannot weight a beam (n < 2
column2: or a variance under 0.0005 dB^2 that would print as 0.000): treat such a beam as uncorrectable; se_db is empty wherever it is not finite; the offset columns are empty for an unanchored mode; declared_tvg_absorption_db_per_km is nan for MIXED or an undeclared absorption; columns that do not apply to a row (var_db2 and db_relative_to_nadir on range rows
column3: the angle bounds on angle rows) are empty; x is written with 10 significant digits
